note: Scan policy. Exclusion rules are data, not code — one user's junk is not the next user's junk.
thresholdNote: Both signals are required and neither suffices alone. Cheat directories (.cht, .ps3savepatch) score 100% homogeneity and 0% conformance, so homogeneity alone swallows 2,378 files. PSP\Roms is 90 bare .iso files with no archive wrapper, which conformance admits and an extension allowlist would reject. These values are the ones validated against the 22,050-file reference drive; changing them is not a casual edit.
minimumFileCountNote: Below this, both signals are noise rather than evidence — a two-file directory is trivially 100% homogeneous.
incompleteDownloadNote: Signals of a transfer still in flight, NOT proof. A real 0.99 GB file missing 16 MB was observed with no incomplete extension and a full pre-allocated size — it passes every cheap check. Full verification is a later phase.
recentWriteNote: How recently a file must have been written to count as still in flight. The weakest in-progress signal and the only circumstantial one — it infers activity from a timestamp rather than observing it. Lower it if you routinely curate a set immediately after copying it; raise it if downloads trickle in slowly.
discDescriptorNote: A disc image's track sheet. An archive holding one of these plus its data files is a disc image — correct structure the stubbed disc resolver does not handle yet — not an archive that wrongly contains two games. 1,762 of 1,765 PlayStation archives on the reference drive are .bin + .cue, and classifying them as anomalies buried the five genuinely corrupt archives underneath.
excludedDirectoryNamesNote: Matched against EVERY segment of a directory's path, not just its leaf, so an entry here excludes the whole subtree beneath it. Otherwise a mostly-empty container would be excluded while the ROM sets nested under it were still admitted. Beyond ARK's own quarantine this is an escape hatch: the two signals already reject emulators, tooling, firmware and cheats on the reference drive, and a name blocklist is the folder-name reasoning this classifier exists to avoid. Add entries for directories your own drive gets wrong.
quarantineNote: ARK's quarantine lands INSIDE the tree it deduplicated. Without this entry a later scan walks into it and finds conformant archives scoring high on both signals, so quarantined units re-enter the pipeline as live candidates — and a later run could pick a quarantined copy as the one to keep. An operation's output must not become the next operation's input.
knownFalsePositiveNote: Passes both signals and still is not games. 'Nintendo - Wii U - Disc Keys' is 516 flawlessly No-Intro-named archives containing disc keys. Conformant naming does not prove game content. These are admitted but flagged, so the gap is visible rather than silent; a third signal on folder qualifier or archive contents is future work.
